text: Coffee with Ayo after the client call. Her manager Barbara is retiring sometime after Christmas and Ayo might go for the role. She's flying to Lagos on 14 December 2026 for her cousin's wedding. She's also been learning Yoruba properly so she can talk to her gran. Need to ask her how the chat with Barbara goes on Friday.
Colm rang. He and Petra are finally doing Japan in the spring, two weeks, flying via Helsinki. He's dreading the long flight with his bad back. Their dog Biscuit is going to his mum's.
Eli says the Henderson account is moving to Georgia's team next Tuesday. He's not thrilled. Georgia seemed fine about it.
Lunch w James. Promoted to senior designer, starts the new title 2 November 2026. His wife Mai is expecting in March 2027! Send them both congrats.
Bao back from Vietnam yesterday, says the 13 hour flight was brutal but worth it. Saw his grandmother for the first time in six years. He brought me coffee beans.

Quick catch up with Chris. His team are being restructured soon, he doesn't know if his job's safe. Redundancy meeting is next Thursday. His wife Nora is just about to go back to work after maternity leave too, so the timing couldn't be worse. Check in with him after.
Rhys's trip to Iceland is off, his boss wouldn't sign off the leave. He's going to try again in the new year.

Long one with Esme tonight. She's been really struggling since her dad's diagnosis, he starts chemo in a fortnight and she's driving him to every session. Her brother Julien lives in Montreal and can't get back until sometime in January. She's also trying to keep on top of the Morgan pitch at work, which is due Friday, and her manager Karim has been decent about it. I should drop off dinner this weekend and maybe offer to cover one of the hospital runs.
Tamar - vegan, don't book the steak place for the team dinner.
Mai's mum is having knee surgery on the 9th. Mai flying up to Glasgow the day before.
Agnieszka mentioned she's applying for the Berlin office transfer. Interview is sometime next month. She's quite nervous, hasn't done one in ten years. Wish her luck.
Asha and Marcus are getting married in Lisbon in June 2027! Save the date coming soon apparently. Marcus wants a small do, Asha's mum wants 200 people.
Julien says his new boss Sofia is great, very hands off. He's settling in at the agency. Still commuting from Brighton three days a week.
Called Karim re the Osei contract. Client wants revised figures by tomorrow. He's off to Dubai Wednesday for the conference so I need to get him the deck tonight.
Duc's daughter starts nursery Monday. He's more nervous than she is. Ask him how the first week went.

Joe and Nora had their housewarming Saturday. Lovely flat in Leith. Nora's into pottery now, has a wheel in the spare room. Joe mentioned she's been eyeing a kiln, could be a good birthday present for later in the year.
Noah's driving test is next Wednesday at 9. Fourth attempt. Text him good luck Tuesday night.
Fang flew out to Singapore this morning for three weeks, her sister's having a baby. Back around 10 November.
Book dentist. Renew passport before the Spain trip in April 2027.

Bumped into Lachlan at the station. He's leaving the firm at the end of the month, going freelance. Leaving drinks probably the Friday after. He also mentioned his partner Shanice got into the Royal Academy summer show.

Kofi's been signed off with stress for two weeks. His manager Darius has been piling on the Barros work since August. Kofi said he's ok but didn't sound it. His girlfriend Asha wants him to take a proper break, maybe a week in Portugal before Christmas. Need to give him a ring at the weekend, not about work.
Tomás. Running the Valencia marathon on 6 December 2026. Training's going ok, calf niggle. Big into trail running too.
Juan's dad passed away last Sunday. Funeral is Thursday in Seville, Juan flies out tomorrow. Send flowers to his mum's place and message Juan.
Shanice was promoted to head of client services! Announced at the all-hands this morning. Her old boss James is chuffed. Drinks Thursday to celebrate.
Georgia says Petra in finance is going on maternity leave sometime in the spring, and nobody's sorted cover yet. Georgia's worried it'll land on her.
Barbara (Babs) from accounts - grandson Eli turned 1 at the weekend. She showed me about 40 photos. Loves gardening, grows dahlias.
Sofia and Duc are off to Peru in a fortnight, three weeks, Machu Picchu trek included. Duc's terrified of heights. Ask how the trek went when they're back.
Annual review with Karim went fine. Pay rise kicks in January. I'm taking the team out for lunch next Friday.

Talked to Chris about the stag. Rhys's stag is in Krakow 20-22 November, Chris is organising, I'm doing the flights. Rhys and Georgia's wedding is 3 April 2027. Georgia's hen is the weekend before, somewhere in the Cotswolds. Rhys is getting nervous about his speech already.
Ayo's son Kofi got into Edinburgh uni! Starting next September. She's proud but already sad about him moving out.
Mrs Shah next door asked me to feed her cat Pickle while she's in Mumbai. She goes Saturday, back the following Sunday. Key under the plant pot.
Colm's sister Nora is moving to Sydney after Christmas with her husband. Colm's gutted, they're close. His mum's not taking it well either. Might be nice to take Colm for a pint soon.

Asha called from the airport, flight to Toronto delayed four hours. She's presenting to the Jensen people Monday morning and is panicking about jet lag. Message her Monday afternoon to see how it went.
Gym, then groceries. Haircut Thursday.
Esme's back from Crete, brown as a nut. She wants to go back next summer with Tamar and the kids. Esme's 40th is in early February, she's dropping hints about a weekend in Paris.

Marcus mentioned his boss Darius is leaving in March 2027, going to a competitor. Marcus wants Darius's job but thinks they'll hire externally. He's got a coffee with HR next Tuesday about it. Meanwhile his twins start secondary in September and he's been touring schools every weekend. Ask him after Tuesday how HR went.
Petra's parents are visiting from Prague next week, first time meeting the baby. She's cleaning the house top to bottom.

Catch up with Lachlan and his wife Fang on Zoom. They're in Melbourne till February. Lachlan's started a new job at a fintech, likes it. Fang's pregnant, due in May 2027, though she's had awful morning sickness. Their kids are loving the school there. They might come back to London for a visit in the summer. Remember to post the kids' Christmas presents by the end of November so they get there in time.
Joe said the client in Leeds cancelled Thursday's workshop, so he's free. We're doing the Brighton site visit together instead.
Agnieszka's mum is coming over from Kraków for Christmas, staying six weeks. Agnieszka is stressed already. Her flat is tiny.
Remind me to ask Juan about his Mexico trip, he went last month to see his grandparents in Oaxaca.
Shanice can't eat gluten, coeliac. Doing a bake sale on Friday so need to grab something she can have.
Tamar's band has a gig at the Lexington on Saturday 7 November 2026. She plays bass. I'm going with Bao.
James Thomas (Jim to everyone) from the Williams account is retiring at Christmas after 30 years. Client wants a send-off in mid December. I should get a card going round the team.
Noah and his girlfriend Asha just got back from a month in Thailand. Noah got food poisoning in Bangkok but recovered. They're already planning Vietnam for next year.
Shanice mentioned her brother Kofi has an audition at the Royal Northern next Monday. He's been practising cello every night. She thinks he's got a real shot.
Karim's wife Sofia had her scan yesterday, all fine. It's a girl. They're over the moon.

Eli's flying to New York tomorrow for the Fernández pitch, back Thursday. If it lands he's up for promotion in the spring. Need to text him good luck in the morning and then ask how it went at the end of the week.
Rang Dad. He's thinking about a cruise sometime next year. Wants me to help look at options this weekend.
Mai says Ayo is leaving the agency, last day 30 October. Mai's organising a collection. Chip in a tenner.
Georgia's anniversary with Tomás is on Sunday, 10 years. He's taking her to Rome for the weekend as a surprise, she doesn't know.

Coffee with Darius. He's been having a hard time with his new manager, feels micromanaged. Looking around for other roles quietly. Has a second interview at Ocado on 28 October, and a first round somewhere in Manchester sometime next month. He's anxious about it, says he always blanks. Check in after.
Julien's cat Mochi went missing on Tuesday. He's put posters up everywhere. Gutted. Check if he's found her by the weekend.
Juan O'Brien is the new account director, starting Monday. Ex-Deloitte. Supposed to be very sharp, also a keen climber apparently.
Barbara is off to Kenya in January on safari with her sister. Her first long haul since her hip operation. She asked if I'd recommend any travel insurance.

Bao and Esme came for dinner. Bao's starting a part time MBA in the new year, alongside work. Esme is training for a triathlon in the summer. Esme mentioned she wants a new road bike but they're saving for the house. Bao's mum is unwell again so he's flying to Hanoi for two weeks, leaving Tuesday 3 November 2026. Esme's going with him for the first week. Send Bao a message while he's away to see how his mum is doing.
Duc's presentation to the board is next Wednesday. He's prepped loads but says he's sick with nerves.
Chris and his husband Joe are adopting! Panel meeting is sometime in December. Fingers crossed.

Lunch with Nora. Moving to Bristol in the spring, her partner got a job at the uni. She'll keep working remotely. Hates the idea of house hunting. Loves wild swimming, says the docks are full of swimmers.
Flights to Bangkok booked for 15 March 2027. Pay the hotel deposit by Friday.
